description: Manual output-semantics review (pass 3). Every task in the pilot and main manifests and every task in the pass-3 candidate pool had its public Output section (and, where needed, Constraints) read by hand. Tasks listed here are those with any non-exact cue; every other reviewed task is single-answer and compared exactly. Public statement text only; no hidden tests, solutions or model outcomes were consulted.
judge_rule: judge 0.2.1 outputs_match: stripped lines, equal line count, identical line or equal Decimal lists
reviewed_sets: pass-3 candidate pool (25 AtCoder test6 tasks outside main, pass 1 and pass 2)

lcb-atcoder-abc392_d.evidence: Your answer is considered correct if the absolute or relative error from the true solution does not exceed 10^{-8}.
lcb-atcoder-abc392_d.note: pass-1 known false negative: 0.3333333333333333 is rejected against 0.333333333333333

lcb-atcoder-abc396_e.evidence: If there are multiple good sequences with the same minimum sum, printing any of them is accepted.
lcb-atcoder-abc396_e.note: pass-1 known false negative; reference validator in guided_agent/checkers.py

lcb-atcoder-abc397_d.evidence: If there are multiple solutions, printing any one of them is accepted as correct.

lcb-atcoder-abc398_f.evidence: If multiple solutions exist, any of them is accepted.

lcb-atcoder-arc190_a.evidence: If there are multiple ways that minimize the total cost, printing any one of them is accepted.

lcb-atcoder-arc191_c.evidence: If there are multiple valid solutions, any one of them is considered correct.

lcb-atcoder-arc192_b.evidence: The judge is case-insensitive; for example, if the correct answer is Fennec, outputs such as fennec, FENNEC, or fEnNeC will also be accepted.
lcb-atcoder-arc192_b.note: pass-3 pool: excluded. Missed by the pass-2 keyword regex.

lcb-atcoder-arc192_a.evidence: The judge is case-insensitive; for example, if the correct answer is Yes, outputs such as yes, YES, or yEs will also be accepted.
lcb-atcoder-arc192_a.note: pass-1 development task. All 10 pass-1/pass-2 submissions print canonical Yes/No, so no historical false negative arose.

lcb-atcoder-abc395_a.evidence: The judge is case-insensitive. For example, if the correct answer is Yes, any of yes, YES, and yEs will be accepted.
lcb-atcoder-abc395_a.note: MAIN manifest. Exact comparison is correct only if the program prints canonical case; false-negative risk for the final benchmark.

lcb-atcoder-arc195_c.evidence: Determine whether there is a way to place the (R+B) pieces satisfying these conditions. If it exists, show one example.
lcb-atcoder-arc195_c.note: MAIN manifest. Constructive output with no 'any' wording: exact comparison rejects almost every correct program. Must be excluded or given a validator before the final benchmark.
